item.title: K8S Service Proxy Mode in Practice: Deep Dive from iptables Three-Tier Chains to Kernel IPVS Tuning
item.description: A deep dive into Kubernetes Service underlying traffic forwarding mechanisms, comparing the performance differences between iptables and IPVS, deconstructing the iptables three-tier chain probabilistic traffic distribution using kube-dns, and providing a complete hands-on guide to switching kube-proxy to IPVS mode in production.
